summary: This directory manages the translation layer between internal application tools and the Vercel AI SDK. It ensures that internal function definitions are correctly serialized and adapted to satisfy the technical requirements of the external platform interface.
responsibilities: Transforming internal tool abstractions into Vercel-compatible schemas
Validating tool definitions against platform-specific constraints
relationships: The adapter maps internal tool representations to the specific data structures required by Vercel.
Transformation logic ensures that tool metadata adheres to external SDK interface specifications.
designDecisions: Usage of test-driven development to ensure schema compliance
